newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Autogrill posts higher 1996 sales.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Autogrill posts higher 1996 sales.

text.p: Italian roadside restaurant chain Autogrill said it had 1996 sales of 1.77 trillion lire, and forecast turnover will rise to more than 2.2 trillion lire in 1999, with increased investments and expansion in Europe.
The group, controlled by the Benetton family's Edizione Holding financial company, gave the figures to mark the inauguration in Madrid of two new Autogrill restaurants.
Autogrill had 1995 sales of 1.61 trillion lire.
Autogrill said it looked to grow in Europe with its Spizzico pizza chain, which had 1996 turnover of 65 billion lire, up 38 percent, and will soon open its 100th restaurant.
Autogrill chairman Gilberto Benetton, speaking in Madrid, said the number of Spizzico restaurants should increase to 220 by 1999 with turnover of 200 billion lire.
Autogrill currently has 475 restaurants in the main cities and major highways in France and Spain and recently announced its entry into the Greek market.

At an analysts' meeting at the beginning of December, Autogrill had forecast an increase in 1996 group turnover of six to seven percent and of three to four percent in operating margins. It posted operating profits of 74.8 billion lire in 1995.
